_source: House rule. Not a Cyberpunk RED rules value.
_rules: What each Role REACHES FOR, written for the narrator rather than for the engine. Nothing here changes a number, sets a DV, or grants a character anything: roles.json and roleAbility.ts stay the sole authority on what a Role Ability does and what Rank reaches how far. This file exists because the Role was only ever described to the model as a prohibition — 'nothing above that Rank' — so a Rockerboy and a Nomad were offered the same three things to do. `reach` is one line of who this person is in a room. `options` are the SHAPES of move only this Role would think of, offered as examples to think with and never to be read back verbatim.

rockerboy.reach: People are the lever. They read a room for who wants to be led, and a crowd is something they can point.
options: work the room — find who everyone else is watching and get to them
play, speak or perform where it will be heard, and let the crowd do the pushing
make a private thing public: name it loudly, in front of the people it embarrasses
trade on being known — the door opens because of who is asking

solo.reach: They read a room for exits, angles and who is armed, and they were ready before it started.
options: take the ground first — the angle, the doorway, the high side
pick which one drops first, and why that one
call the fight before it starts: move on the one reaching
read the threat and say plainly what this becomes if it goes loud

netrunner.reach: Every wall here has something running inside it, and they can hear it.
options: find the architecture behind the building and what it is guarding
look for the jack-in point nobody thinks of as a door

tech.reach: Nothing here is a fixed object. It is parts, and they know which ones are load-bearing.
options: open the thing up and find out why it actually failed
make the broken one work for a while — badly, but now
sabotage something so it fails later and looks like wear
build or bodge the tool this job needs out of what is on the bench

medtech.reach: They see injuries, not wounds — what is survivable, what is hours away from killing someone, and what it would cost to fix.
options: work on someone here instead of moving them
read the body: what did this, how long ago, and did they walk away
trade treatment for what you actually want
get into somewhere on the strength of being the one who can help

media.reach: Everything here is either a story or a source, and they are always deciding which.
options: get it on record — camera, recorder, a witness who will say it again
ask the question nobody in this room is supposed to ask
offer to leave a name out, and find out what that is worth
trade on the piece you have not run yet

exec.reach: Somebody owns this, somebody signs for it, and they know how to find out which.
options: find out who this actually reports to
have someone else do it, and be elsewhere when it happens
make it a procurement problem instead of a fight
spend the company's name where it still means something

lawman.reach: The badge is a key and a target, and they can usually tell which it will be before they show it.
options: show the badge and see what the room does
run the name, the plate, the face against what the department holds
lean on someone who has more to lose from a report than from you
call it in — get people with armor here and let them be the argument

fixer.reach: Everything has a price and a second price, and they know who is holding.
options: push the number — the first one is never the one
find who moves this kind of thing in this district
sell what is in hand to the person who wants it most
call in what somebody already owes rather than paying

nomad.reach: They came in with wheels and they know the way out, which changes what is worth trying.
options: do it from the vehicle, and keep the engine running
work out the route out of here before doing anything else
ask the road — another family has been through this and talked about it
put the vehicle between the problem and whoever needs covering
